c04f1acca2237b04.description: نبذة عن شركة قناة الإقليمية تُعد شركة قناة الإقليمية من الشركات الرائدة في القطاع الصناعي والتجاري بالمملكة العربية السعودية. تتخصص الشركة في تصنيع وتوريد وتسويق المواد الصحية، بما في ذلك مواسير وأنابيب المياه والغاز (PVC / CPVC)، التجهيزات الصحية، الخلاطات، إكسسوارات الحمامات، ومستلزمات السباكة. تعمل الشركة تحت علامات تجارية بارزة مثل Chanal، Santech، وDonna. حول وظيفة مندوب المبيعات تبحث شركة قناة الإقليمية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الترويج لمنتجات الشركة من المواد والتجهيزات الصحية ومواسير المياه والغاز. كما يركز على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء المستهدفين، وتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية والتسويقية، وتوسيع حصة الشركة في السوق المحلي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحقيق الخطط والمستهدفات البيعية الشهرية والربع سنوية لمنتجات الشركة (المواسير، الخلاطات، الأدوات الصحية). البحث عن عملاء جدد واستقطاب مشاريع جديدة (مقاولات، مجمعات سكنية، تجار جملة وتجزئة). زيارة المعارض الحليفة، محلات السباكة، وشركات المقاولات بشكل دوري لتقديم عروض الأسعار والتعريف بمنتجات العلامة التجارية. تنفيذ خطط التسويق الميداني والمشاركة في إبراز المنتجات وعرضها داخل نقاط البيع ومعارض العملاء. دراسة السوق وتحليل المنافسين، ورصد أسعار واتجاهات السوق في قطاع المواد الصحية ومواد البناء، وتقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة. جمع ملاحظات العملاء والشكاوى (إن وجدت) والعمل على حلها بالتنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية لضمان رضا العملاء. إتمام عقود البيع، ومتابعة عمليات التسليم والتحصيل المالي بالتعاون مع القسم المالي والإداري. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد ومستدامة مع العملاء الحاليين والحفاظ على ولائهم للعلامة التجارية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع المواد الصحية أو مواد البناء. القدرة على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية وتطوير الأعمال. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تعزيز مكانة الشركة في السوق المحلي. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة قناة الإقليمية.

This role involves providing advanced technical support and maintenance services to naval forces in the Kingdom. The position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and is offered on a contract basis. As a Field Service Technician / Sonar Technician, you will provide on-site technical assistance for towed sonar systems fitted on naval corvettes. Role Context and Scope The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure the operational readiness and maintenance of towed sonar systems. This involves both preventive and corrective maintenance activities. While primarily based in Jeddah, Makkah, deployment to other sites may be required based on operational customer needs. The role requires a strong understanding of sonar systems and adherence to OEM procedures and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Perform in-depth diagnostics to identify technical faults in towed sonar systems, utilizing available maintenance resources. Conduct planned preventive maintenance to minimize downtime, extend equipment life, and ensure system availability for operations, including organizational and intermediate levels (OLM/ILM). Execute corrective maintenance, including repairs and replacement of faulty components at OLM/ILM level, based on available tools and spare parts. Maintain detailed records of all maintenance work, identified problems, and implemented fixes, submitting regular reports to the chain of command. Assist in inventory management by tracking incoming and outgoing spare parts. Ensure all maintenance activities comply with OEM procedures and are conducted safely. Contribute to the preparation of the Annual Engineering Support Plan, estimating required engineering support activities for each period. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven experience with diagnostics, preventive, and corrective maintenance of complex technical systems, preferably sonar systems. Familiarity with organizational and intermediate level maintenance (OLM/ILM). Ability to maintain detailed documentation and generate reports. Understanding of spare parts management principles. Adherence to OEM procedures and safety regulations. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential deployments to other operational sites as needed. The role involves working directly with naval forces and requires a commitment to maintaining high technical standards and operational readiness. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

c0bda257d9f48f21.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة الخريف لزيوت التشحيم عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. تهدف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل إلى ضمان دقة وسلامة البيانات من خلال مراجعة الاستمارات وإدخال المعلومات وتخزينها بكفاءة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمال جميع المعلومات المطلوبة. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي وفقًا للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء موجودة لضمان الدقة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. إجراء النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. الالتزام الصارم بالتعليمات والسياسات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل عند التعامل مع البيانات. مهارات جيدة في استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالتعليمات. الالتزام بمعايير السرية وحماية البيانات. موقع العمل يقع مقر هذه الوظيفة في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

c0dac33190b0e904.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Director of Marketing to lead and oversee the marketing strategy and initiatives for its hotel operations in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah, and focuses on strengthening the hotel’s brand presence, driving awareness and demand, and developing innovative marketing campaigns. The successful candidate will support business objectives and enhance guest engagement. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the hotel’s overall marketing strategy and annual marketing plan. Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, PR, content, and traditional channels. Strengthen brand positioning and ensure consistent brand communication across all platforms. Develop strategies to increase brand awareness, revenue, market share, and guest engagement. Manage the hotel’s digital presence, including website, social media, email marketing, and online campaigns. Collaborate closely with Sales, Revenue Management, Operations, and other departments to support commercial objectives. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify new opportunities. Manage the marketing budget and ensure effective allocation of resources. Oversee external agencies, suppliers, media partners, and marketing projects. Measure campaign performance and prepare regular reports with recommendations for improvement. Lead and develop the marketing team, fostering creativity, collaboration, and high performance. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Hospitality, or a related field. Minimum 5–7 years of progressive marketing experience, preferably within the hospitality or hotel industry. Proven experience in developing and executing successful marketing strategies and campaigns. Strong knowledge of digital marketing, social media, content marketing, and brand management. Experience managing marketing budgets and external agencies. Strong knowledge of the local market and hospitality industry is preferred. Required Skills Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and strategic thinking with a results-oriented mindset. c02f7afe7ffe8e74.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Lead Commissioning Superintendent, Instrumentation, to oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of instrumentation and control systems for new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. This full-time position is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region, and focuses on ensuring safe, reliable system operation, regulatory compliance, and successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and implementation of instrumentation commissioning plans, procedures, inspection and test plans (ITPs), method statements, schedules, and resource requirements. Direct the commissioning, testing, calibration, verification, and startup of instrumentation systems, including pressure, temperature, flow, level, vibration monitoring, and associated field devices. Lead functional testing, integration, and performance verification of control valves, actuators, Fire & Gas systems, ESD/SIS loops, and critical safety instrumented functions. Oversee loop checks, calibration activities, functional testing, energization, FATs, SATs, and system performance verification. Manage commissioning interfaces among engineering, construction, operations, OEM vendors, client representatives, and classification societies. Oversee the commissioning and integration of drilling instrumentation, HVAC/BMS controls, monitoring systems, and auxiliary instrumentation packages. Direct commissioning activities in accordance with project specifications, API, IEC, classification society requirements, and quality standards. Promote and enforce compliance with permit-to-work systems, SIMOPS requirements, risk assessments, toolbox talks, and project HSE procedures. Oversee the preparation, review, and closeout of commissioning documentation, including check sheets, loop folders, test reports, red-line markups, vendor reports, ITRs, MC/RFCC/RFOC certificates, and handover dossiers. Direct punch-list management, construction-to-commissioning transitions, readiness assessments, as-built documentation, O&M manual development, and final handover activities. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical & Instrumentation, or an equivalent technical discipline. Experience: 12-15 years of experience in instrumentation commissioning, with a minimum of 8 years in offshore rigs, ideally jack-up rig newbuilds. Professional Qualifications: Knowledge of Omega 365 PIMS is beneficial. Equivalent experience in drilling or rig construction & commissioning is also beneficial. Hands-on experience with: Drilling control systems Integrated Control & Safety Systems (ICSS) Fire & Gas, Marine & ESD systems DP & jacking systems instrumentation (if applicable) Work Environment This role operates within the dynamic environment of new-build offshore jack-up drilling rig projects, requiring coordination with various stakeholders including engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and classification societies. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c0408f347ebba316.description: About Dnata Travel Group Dnata is a partner to leading airlines, travel management organizations, and brands within the travel industry. The company's expertise spans business travel management, worldwide tour operations, group and incentive arrangements, specialized management services, advanced information technology systems, and travel retailing. Dnata maintains a culture of excellence, focusing on continuous product innovation and high service standards. The Role of Accounts Assistant The Accounts Assistant supports the revenue and finance functions by processing accounting information accurately and in a timely manner. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and requires 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Receipt cash and debtor collections by referencing the cash book and debtors ledger to ensure accurate reflection of receivables in financial statements. Prepare and process payment vouchers by checking supporting documents, bills, making cheque and cash payments, coding vouchers with cost center and account codes, and entering them into the ERP system. Apply creditor settlements in the payables ledger by selecting dues as per references from leisure supplier statements to accurately reflect payables in financial statements. Check all daily sales reports from all locations for completeness and accuracy regarding applicable commission rates, taxes, fares, and rebates. Carry out corrections (re-invoicing) for invoices issued on a cash basis instead of credit invoices (corporates) to ensure accurate recording of debtors as per finance department requirements. Supervise daily banking to ensure proper internal control, clear customer advances, and carry out receipting to ensure debtors are accurately reflected. Submit UCCF to airlines that accept UCCF - Airline Accepted Card. Assist in checking refund calculations and preparing credit notes to ensure BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan by IATA) payable accuracy and customer satisfaction. Assist in processing corporate invoicing by sorting and arranging supporting documents as per specific corporate requirements. Perform any other tasks assigned by management as per operational requirements. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in an accounting or finance support role. Ability to process accounting information accurately and efficiently. Familiarity with financial policies and procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Dnata Travel Group, located in Al Khobar, Eastern region. The role involves working within a team dedicated to maintaining high standards of financial accuracy and operational efficiency. Application Information Dnata is committed to providing employees with opportunities for career growth and development. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

c06a68fee705395c.description: About the Role SEVEN (Saudi Entertainment Ventures) is seeking a Finance Manager to join their team in Taif, Makkah Province. This full-time role involves serving as the embedded finance business partner for Operations, providing financial leadership, strategic insights, and decision support to venue management teams. The Finance Manager will be instrumental in driving profitability and cost optimization across entertainment destinations. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to manage the financial performance of assigned entertainment venues. This includes analyzing revenue streams, monitoring operating costs, and ensuring financial targets are met. The Finance Manager will act as a trusted advisor to operations managers, translating financial data into actionable insights and influencing strategic decisions from the initial planning stages. Key Responsibilities Manage venue P&L performance by overseeing financial results for assigned destinations, analyzing revenue streams (tickets, F&B, retail, attractions), and monitoring operating costs to achieve EBITDA and profitability targets. Provide financial business partnering by advising venue and operations managers, participating in operational planning, and translating financial data into actionable insights. Analyze operational metrics, including per capita spend, attendance versus forecast, revenue per visitor, labor cost ratios, and F&B margins, and recommend improvements. Support budgeting and forecasting by collaborating with venue managers to develop accurate financial plans, incorporating seasonality, event calendars, and operational capacity, and providing variance analysis. Drive cost optimization by identifying opportunities to reduce operating costs, analyzing labor scheduling efficiency, monitoring vendor costs, and implementing cost control initiatives. Ensure financial controls by overseeing cash handling procedures, monitoring inventory management and shrinkage, ensuring compliance with financial policies, and supporting audits. Develop and lead the operations finance team by setting objectives, providing coaching and mentorship, and fostering a high-performing environment. Experience Requirements Candidates for this position should possess 6 to 7 years of relevant experience in finance, preferably within an operational or entertainment industry context. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Taif, Makkah Province, within the dynamic environment of entertainment venues. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

c075bf21e91bf882.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
c075bf21e91bf882.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a Research User Computing Linux Specialist to join their team in Thuwal, Makkah. This full-time role involves designing, operating, and continuously improving KAUST's Linux-based research end-user computing platforms. The specialist will ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance access to scientific desktop environments for faculty, researchers, and students. Role Purpose and Scope The primary purpose of this position is to manage and enhance Linux-based systems, including Ubuntu and Rocky Linux endpoints, physical scientific workstations, and virtual scientific workstation services. The specialist will be instrumental in supporting the research and academic communities by providing stable and secure scientific computing environments. Key Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and improve Ubuntu and Rocky Linux end-user platforms to deliver stable and secure scientific workstation services. Develop, standardize, and maintain Linux workstation builds and images for physical and virtual scientific desktops. Manage and support remote scientific workstation platforms, including NICE DCV and Kasm Workspaces. Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, monitoring, and compliance activities using scripting, configuration management, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps-aligned practices. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Linux endpoints, workstations, remote desktops, GPUs, drivers, performance, identity, storage, and networks. Integrate Linux desktops and workstations with enterprise IAM, storage, network, monitoring, security, and endpoint management services. Collaborate with faculty, researchers, students, research labs, HPC, storage, security, and advanced computing teams to translate scientific workflow requirements into sustainable workstation solutions. Support the installation, validation, and maintenance of scientific and research software on Linux workstation environments. Implement and maintain security and compliance controls for Linux workstation environments, including patching, hardening, audit logging, and endpoint security. Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, user guidance, dashboards, and service metrics. Evaluate new Linux desktop, remote access, virtualization, automation, and scientific workstation technologies. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Linux system administration and end-user computing support. Work Environment and Conditions This is a full-time position based in Thuwal, Makkah, at KAUST. The role involves working within a dynamic research and academic environment, collaborating with various technical and research teams to support advanced scientific computing needs. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

c080d16a494297bc.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking a Project Controls Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is crucial for a major Roads and Highways project, focusing on planning, scheduling, cost control, progress monitoring, risk management, reporting, and performance measurement. The Project Controls Manager will ensure project objectives are met through effective systems, accurate forecasting, and timely reporting to the Client, Project Director, and senior management. Key Responsibilities The successful candidate will lead the project controls team, collaborating with clients, contractors, designers, and supervision teams to monitor project performance, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions. Responsibilities include: Developing, reviewing, and maintaining the master project schedule using Primavera P6. Evaluating Contractors' baseline schedules, recovery schedules, and revised programs. Monitoring schedule performance, identifying critical path activities, and conducting schedule risk analysis. Reviewing and assessing Extension of Time (EOT) submissions. Establishing project control procedures, KPIs, and reporting systems. Preparing weekly and monthly progress reports, providing schedule variance analysis and forecasting. Monitoring project budgets, commitments, expenditures, and forecasts, and analyzing cost trends. Supporting commercial and contract teams in assessing variations and claims. Maintaining the project risk register and mitigation plans, and coordinating risk review workshops. Assessing contractor claims related to delays, disruptions, and productivity losses. Coordinating with Client representatives, contractors, authorities, and project teams. Managing and mentoring planners, cost engineers, and project controls engineers. Project Monitoring and Reporting This role involves establishing robust project control procedures and reporting systems. Key tasks include monitoring project progress against approved schedules and milestones, preparing detailed progress reports for both the Client and senior management, and developing executive dashboards to provide clear performance overviews. Cost Control and Risk Management The Project Controls Manager will be responsible for vigilant cost control, including monitoring budgets, commitments, and expenditures, and identifying potential overruns through trend analysis. Additionally, the role encompasses comprehensive risk management, involving the identification of schedule, cost, and operational risks, and the coordination of mitigation measures with stakeholders. Claims and Change Management A critical aspect of this position is the assessment of contractor claims related to delays, disruptions, and productivity losses. The manager will support the evaluation of variation orders and change requests, review supporting records and schedule impact analyses, and provide recommendations on entitlement and time impacts. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a strong background in project controls within the infrastructure sector. A minimum of 10 years of experience in a similar role is required, with demonstrated expertise in Primavera P6 and comprehensive project controls methodologies. The ability to lead a team and coordinate effectively with diverse stakeholders is essential.

c0fad2904b48db72.description: About the Role Alfanar Projects is seeking a Document Controller to manage and organize the flow of documents, ensuring secure storage and seamless access across departments. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires 0-1 years of experience. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage, organize, and control all aspects of document flow, including handling, updating, storage, and disposal. The Document Controller will be responsible for preparing reports, archiving documents, and ensuring that all documentation is stored safely and securely, while also facilitating easy access for relevant departments. Key Responsibilities Organize, store, retrieve, and distribute documents efficiently, ensuring proper labeling, filing, and archiving according to company standards. Monitor document revisions and remove obsolete versions. Facilitate communication and smooth document exchange between departments. Coordinate with project teams to meet deadlines and ensure timely document delivery. Provide support and training to staff on document management systems. Stay updated on industry regulations related to document management and ensure all documents meet legal and regulatory requirements. Assist with documentation required for audits and inspections. Monitor the performance of document management systems, suggest improvements, and troubleshoot software issues. Develop and implement best practices for document control to enhance efficiency. Identify potential document management risks and implement mitigation strategies. Establish backup and recovery procedures to protect documents and collaborate with IT to ensure adherence to document security protocols. Execute planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules, utilizing resources efficiently within cost and time constraints. c03fcb6355c03dcc.description: About the Role Al-Futtaim is seeking an Accountant Al Futtaim Automotive Finance to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing cash flow, invoicing, and financial controls within a multi-brand showroom and workshop environment. The position supports the Finance Business Partner to ensure precise financial reporting and provides effective business support, with a primary focus on revenue collection, accounts receivable management, and compliance with financial policies. Key Responsibilities Collect and verify all cash, credit card, and cheque payments against invoices, and post all collections in the SAP system. Monitor the petty cash fund to ensure an adequate balance and review pending reimbursements/claims for submission. Maintain and balance daily collection and petty cash fund twice daily. Ensure all collected revenue is deposited in the bank. Monitor and communicate cheque clearance, bouncing cheques, and refund cheques. Ensure accurate data entry in SAP and minimize billing cancellations and advance payments. Adhere strictly to company policy regarding customer refunds and maintain logs for tracking purposes. Monitor branch AR reports daily, weekly, and monthly to ensure timely collection of all outstanding or overdue invoices. Maintain a list of all credit facilities provided to branch credit customers, including credit limit, credit period, main contact details, and credit facility documents. Reconcile credit customer accounts. Maintain documents for IHF deals. Accurately record unaccounted credit. Perform invoicing of parts in a timely manner. Ensure strict adherence to all document processes to meet all bank payments accurately. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. c00a3d666355a45a.description: About Plaza Premium Group Plaza Premium Group is a global company specializing in airport hospitality, established in Hong Kong in 1998. The group operates across four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and airport dining concepts. With over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports worldwide, Plaza Premium Group also provides hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates. The role focuses on driving daily operations, pre-openings, commercial performance, guest satisfaction, team management, and stakeholder relations. Key Responsibilities Direct daily lounge operations across five cities, ensuring adherence to PPG brand standards, service SOPs, and hygiene protocols. Conduct regular operational audits and quality checks across all assigned outlets. Lead operational mobilization and pre-opening setups for new lounge locations in line with the Cluster 2 launch plan. Manage P&L performance for assigned locations, focusing on revenue targets and cost controls (Labor, F&B, EBITDA). c0de84c8af82b511.job_title: Lead Shareholder Engagement and Advocacy Specialist
c0de84c8af82b511.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Lead Shareholder Engagement and Advocacy Specialist to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This contract position focuses on leading shareholder engagement, advocacy, and replenishment support for the IsDB Concessional Fund (ICF). The role involves managing strategic relationships with member countries and partners, coordinating engagement and negotiation processes, and guiding communication and outreach efforts to strengthen the Fund’s value proposition and mobilize sustainable concessional resources. Key Responsibilities Manage and strengthen relationships with existing shareholders and cultivate new strategic relationships with member countries and partners to support ICF replenishment and long-term funding sustainability. Maintain structured and continuous engagement with shareholder focal points to ensure alignment between shareholder priorities, ICF positioning, and institutional follow-up. Support the development and maintenance of stakeholder engagement plans, contact strategies, and follow-up actions for key shareholder constituencies. Develop and maintain a structured shareholder engagement framework, including appropriate stakeholder relationship management tools, tracking mechanisms, and follow-up systems. Lead the preparation and coordination of activities supporting replenishment cycles, shareholder consultations, and funding negotiation rounds. Prepare and maintain stakeholder-specific briefs, engagement notes, talking points, and follow-up matrices for management dialogue with shareholders. Track commitments, pledges, and negotiation progress, and identify issues requiring escalation or targeted intervention. Analyze shareholder priorities, concessional financing interests, aid trends, and engagement patterns to inform ICF outreach and positioning. Translate stakeholder intelligence into practical recommendations that strengthen ICF’s opportunity narrative and value proposition. Support the targeting of engagement efforts by identifying priority shareholders, opportunities, and strategic entry points for advocacy and funding dialogue. Coordinate and maintain a rolling calendar of relevant global and regional outreach events, appraise their strategic relevance, and coordinate ICF participation. Coordinate ICF participation in selected events and platforms, including preparation of engagement objectives, briefs, talking points, presentations, and follow-up actions. Support the organization of strategic engagement events, bilateral meetings, and outreach opportunities with potential shareholders and partners. Guide and coordinate the preparation of shareholder-facing communication and outreach materials, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with ICF priorities. Support continuous engagement and visibility efforts to sustain stakeholder confidence and reinforce ICF’s profile. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess over 10 years of relevant experience in shareholder engagement, advocacy, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage strategic relationships with diverse stakeholders, including government officials and international partners. Proven experience in coordinating complex negotiation processes and replenishment cycles. Strong analytical skills to interpret stakeholder intelligence and translate it into actionable strategies. Excellent communication and outreach coordination skills, with experience in preparing high-quality communication materials. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and is offered on a contract basis. The successful candidate will work within a dynamic international environment, contributing to the strategic objectives of the Islamic Development Bank.

c0f364010b517242.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التزام المنتجات بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة من خلال الفحص والتحليل المستمر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات المنتجات من مراحل التصنيع المختلفة، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لعينات المنتجات والتحقق من مطابقتها لمعايير الجودة المحددة. توثيق نتائج الفحوصات والتحليلات بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة في المنتجات واقتراح التوصيات اللازمة للحد من تأثيرها. مراجعة وتحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة لضمان فعاليتها وتوافقها مع أحدث المعايير. متابعة التطورات في اتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة بالجودة وتحديث المعرفة الفنية باستمرار. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع العينات وإجراء الفحوصات والتحليلات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمعايير الجودة وإجراءاتها. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل تقع الوظيفة في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.
